attributes.context: This text appears in Side Letter B - Kronos, dated July 1, 2007, between the University of Washington and SEIU Local 925, specifically addressing the implementation of the Kronos timekeeping system.

extraction_text: The University has the right to implement the "Kronos" timekeeping system sometime during the life of the Agreement. The University will notify the Union at least 60 days in advance and agrees to consult with the Union on any implementation issues.

attributes.context: Article 32 grants the Employer broad management rights to control, change, and supervise all operations and to direct and assign work, subject to express modifications in the Agreement.

extraction_text: The Employer shall determine the methods, technological means and qualifications of personnel by and for which operations are to be carried out.
